import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p,t,x,v):
    return (p[0]+p[1]*np.cos(p[2]*t)+p[3]*np.sin(p[2]*t)+p[4]*x+p[5]*x*np.exp(-p[6]*x))
p0=[-7.95,8.03,0.131,-2.05,0.045,27.7,0.725]
r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p,t,x,v)-dv_dt, p0)
p=r.x; res=dv_dt-model(p,t,x,v)
print(p.round(5), np.mean(res**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
B=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),t,v,v*np.abs(v),x**2,x*v,np.exp(-t),np.cos(2*p[2]*t),np.sin(2*p[2]*t)])
cc=np.linalg.lstsq(B,res,rcond=None)[0]
print(cc.round(4), np.mean((B@cc-res)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
for i in np.argsort(x)[::25]: print(round(x[i],2), round(res[i],4))
